item.anime_multiverse.hellblaze_the_demo: A black katana with a dark-red edge and a fire in its veins that flashes purple with every hit; its sheath hangs in your free hand. The closer its wielder is to death, the less the sword cares to be held back. 80% more damage while you are under 40% of your health; 4% of the damage comes back to you as life. Use: Hellblaze Slash, Demon Mark and Black Inferno.
